parameters.name: IdentityType
parameters.description: 身份类型，USER: 仅用户名，CLIENT: 具体到客户端

parameters.name: Topic
parameters.description: 授权的topic，支持mqtt多级topic与通配符。

example.unifiedCli: aliyun onsmqtt add-custom-auth-permission --instance-id mqtt-cn-0pp12gl0000 --identity-type USER --identity test --permit-action PUB_SUB --effect ALLOW --topic test/t1 --api-version 2020-04-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun onsmqtt AddCustomAuthPermission --region cn-hangzhou --IdentityType USER --InstanceId 'mqtt-cn-0pp12gl0000' --PermitAction PUB_SUB --Effect ALLOW --Identity test --Topic 'test/t1'
